items.title: A $1,200,000 Portfolio in Clorox, Kimco Realty and Eversource Pays $54,576 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $1,200,000 portfolio split evenly across Clorox, Kimco Realty and Eversource Energy pays $54,576 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $4,550 a month. Clorox’s dividend is the least covered of the three, at 133% of free cash flow over the last 12 months, and analysts expect that to fall to 74% next fiscal year.

items.title: The 401(k) Rollover Mistake That Turns a $4,575 Monthly Paycheck Into a Tax Bill
items.summary: Her old 401(k) plan mailed a check, and it arrived far smaller than her balance. One missing chunk and a 60-day clock could turn a retirement paycheck into a tax problem, and one simple instruction to the plan prevents it.

items.title: Retail Landlords Are Nearly Full, and $120,000 Across These 3 REITs Pays $4,997 a Year
items.summary: Mall, grocery-anchored, and open-air landlords are packing in tenants at levels not seen in years, and each of these three REITs just raised its payout. One simple number tells you whether the checks will keep coming.

items.title: Kimco Realty (KIM) Acquires Two Louisville Shopping Centers For $295 Million
items.summary: Kimco Realty (NYSE:KIM) agreed to acquire two grocery-anchored shopping centers in Louisville for US$295 million. The centers are described as prominent and located in a supply constrained Louisville retail market with high occupancy. Management is using capital recycling for the purchase, targeting remerchandising and below market rents as income growth levers.
